messages.subject: Problems installing INLA
parts:
I'm having some problems installing INLA on my notebook. I am following the paths and addresses presented on the website in detail, but neither address is working. In the final phase of the installation in Rstudio, this message appears: Warning in install.packages :
   downloaded length 0 != reported length 0
Warning in install.packages:
   URL 'https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable/bin/windows/contrib/4.3/INLA_24.02.09.zip': Timeout of 60 seconds was reached
Error in download.file(url, destfile, method, mode = "wb", ...) :
   download from 'https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable/bin/windows/contrib/4.3/INLA_24.02.09.zip' failed
Warning in install.packages:
   download of package ‘INLA’ failed
Could anyone help me resolve this issue?
I thank

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Problems installing INLA
parts:
Do

options(timeout=999999)

And then retry 

—
Haavard Rue

he...@r-inla.org
